+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def search_users(query: str) -> list[dict]:
+    # name contains the query as a case-insensitive substring
+    # ordered by id
+    cursor = _conn.execute(
+        "SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name LIKE ? ORDER BY id",
+        (f"%{query}%",)
+    )
+    return [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_search_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    query = params.get("q")
+    if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid query"}
+    
+    results = users.search_users(query.strip())
+    return 200, {"users": results}

cat <<EOF > tests/test_search.py
from app.api import handlers

def test_handle_search_users():
    # Valid search
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "Ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    # Case-insensitive
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    # Trimmed query
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "  Ada  "})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    # Multiple results
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "a"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 3
    
    # Missing q
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({})
    assert status == 400
    assert data["error"] == "invalid query"

    # Non-string q
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": 123})
    assert status == 400
    assert data["error"] == "invalid query"

    # Blank q
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "   "})
    assert status == 400
    assert data["error"] == "invalid query"
EOF
pytest tests/test_search.py
